prompts.background:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: layered Godot main-menu BACKGROUND only.
Input image is a three-panel comparison sheet; edit ONLY the TOP panel labeled A 星夜银辉. Reconstruct this TOP A architecture background as one clean landscape image, 16:10 aspect ratio, high resolution for 1440x900 display. Remove all typography, every menu label, menu star icons, heroine, A side-strip and comparison borders. Faithfully preserve TOP A's deep navy midnight gothic observatory arcade, dark pillars left and right, richly detailed blue distant spired city, warm tiny windows/candles, glistening dark blue stone terrace and reflecting sky. Reconstruct architecture/terrace naturally behind removed heroine. Preserve top A's delicate luminous silver-gold celestial arcs sweeping across UPPER sky (decorative armillary curves, fine star glints) and painted night sky. Composition must retain a quiet dark left one-third for later live silver title and menus; right two-thirds detailed city, arches and balcony for later heroine. Match A blue-silver nighttime lighting exactly, no amber B or white C. No person, no text, no logo, no UI, no labels, no board subdivisions. Deliver just full-bleed background illustration, do not invent new thematic elements.
prompts.portrait:
Use case: background-extraction, identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent Godot main-menu portrait cutout.
Input image is a three-panel comparison sheet. Isolate and faithfully redraw in higher resolution ONLY the silver-haired praying heroine from the TOP A panel. Preserve EXACT TOP A face, hair silhouette, black-gold small hair ornament, closed eyes, lowered calm front-facing head, hands clasped at upper chest, black fitted long sleeves with fine gold constellation stitching, white shoulder cape and gold-edged black high-collar outfit. No reinterpretation. Her long silver-white flowing hair must spread diagonally to BOTH sides toward bottom exactly as top A. Front-facing HALF-BODY portrait, crown to waist with belt's round clock ornament visible at lower edge; preserve reference aspect/pose, no legs or full body. Centered on a truly TRANSPARENT canvas, near-square or portrait 1:1.15 framed to encompass spread of hair with small margins (no excessive blank padding). Sharp refined anime illustration linework, icy silver highlights and gentle warm skin. No background, no stars outside hair, no typography, no menu, no floor, no separate body parts, no alternate B or C. Alpha background required, preserve delicate hair-edge transparency. This is production compositing asset and must match reference A heroine as closely as possible.
prompts.title:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent artistic game title.
From the TOP A panel only of the input comparison sheet, faithfully isolate/redraw just the exact silver-white artistic Chinese title “未尽之诗” and its fine orbit flourish/starbursts. Four Chinese characters ONLY, preserve their distinctive very thin long verticals and tapered brush terminals, delicate serif/calligraphic silver style as TOP A, subtle crystalline detail but no thick outline or bulky type. Fine pale silver elliptical orbit through/below lettering and several tasteful four-point stars at ends/as reference, airy outline, silver-white luminous. Horizontal composition about 2.8:1 with tight safe margins, high resolution for 550px wide display. True transparent background everywhere outside letters/decorations. No dark rectangle, no architecture/person, no A/B/C, no subtitles, no menu text, no warm gold/blue heavy edging. Do not include the larger star/compass from 新的探索 button. Text must read exactly 未尽之诗.
